outcome: short-term morbidity (preterm birth, presentation anomalies, congenital anomalies, sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis)
cohort: The study included 220 neonates from 126 multiple pregnancies (3 triplets and 123 twins) who were hospitalized in neonatal intensive care units over a four-year period.
finding: Monochorionic pregnancies were associated with lower birth weight and longer duration of total parenteral nutrition.
mod_finding: Birth order had no significant effect on perinatal outcomes.
